description: A corpus source whose local license copy is missing from research/licenses/ must fail.

objects.license_rule: Every source records its license or public-domain basis (license_id, license_basis, license_url), a local copy of the license evidence (license_local_path, license_sha256, license_fetched_at; redistributable copies under research/licenses/, other terms pages under $ORI_CORPORA/licenses/ with URL and SHA-256 only) and a full citation (source_url, source_citation). verification/ori_cl/corpus_license.py enforces this; the corpus tool refuses to ingest a source without it.
